Hello — I'm **john-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This machine is mine to work with for you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, your first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **My own messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want that.
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I'm not fully set up yet: I have no name or gender of my own (john-agent is just the service name), so tell me what to call me and how to speak of me.

I've got your brief — your calendar and messages, working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, and I can reach Professor Alvarez, Sarah and Priya on this channel. I'll read /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md now.

What would you like to start with?
